title: Resume-JD Match Ground Truth Annotation Schema
description: Schema for manual gold annotations of resume-to-job-description matching.

match_id.description: Unique identifier for the pair evaluation (e.g. resume_01__jd_01).

gold_relevant_skills.description: All skills declared relevant by the job description.

gold_matched_skills.description: Subset of relevant skills demonstrably present in the candidate resume.

gold_missing_skills.description: Subset of relevant skills required by JD but absent from the candidate resume.

evaluator_id.description: Anonymized pseudonymous identifier of the annotator (e.g. evaluator_01).

adjudicated.description: Whether this record is a post-disagreement consensus/adjudicated record.
